title: Gideon and the Locker
author: Petra Eastwick
blurb: Juniper Okonkwo, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, has spent five years being so careful it hurts. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must save the tradition that made the town before the final audition.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
